episodes.name: Behold...The Inhumans
episodes.overviewEn: After a military coup leaves the Royal Family stranded in Hawaii, they must find a way to reunite with each other and return home before their way of life is destroyed forever.

episodes.name: Those Who Would Destroy Us
episodes.overviewEn: After a military coup leaves the Royal Family stranded in Hawaii, they must find a way to reunite with each other and return home before their way of life is destroyed forever.

episodes.name: Divide and Conquer
episodes.overviewEn: After fleeing their home, The Inhumans desperately search for each other in the wake of Maximus’ coup. Now they must learn who they can trust on Earth.

episodes.name: Make Way For... Medusa
episodes.overviewEn: The search for Black Bolt continues on Earth; meanwhile, Maximus makes bold moves to cement his status as the new ruler of Attilan.

episodes.name: Something Inhuman This Way Comes...
episodes.overviewEn: On the run from Auran’s forces, Black Bolt and Medusa reluctantly work with Louise to help locate the rest of their family. Back on Attilan, Maximus’ actions change the game completely.

episodes.name: The Gentleman's Name Is Gorgon
episodes.overviewEn: Gorgon and Karnak take on Auran and her Inhuman army with disastrous results.

episodes.name: Havoc in the Hidden Land
episodes.overviewEn: The Royal Family returns to Attilan and comes face to face with Maximus.

episodes.name: ...And Finally: Black Bolt
episodes.overviewEn: It’s brother versus brother as the final showdown between Black Bolt and Maximus takes an unexpected turn – one with lasting consequences for all of Inhumanity.
